profile.headline: Software Engineer @ DoorDash
profile.summary:
I'm an Android engineer with 8 years in software, at tech companies such as DoorDash, Uber, and Yelp.

I'm obsessed with creating rich user experiences. My stack is Kotlin, Java, Jetpack Compose, Coroutines, Dagger/Hilt, MVVM, MVI, Retrofit, server-driven UI, and Python.

I also published Spot, an app on the Google Play Store for saving and finding where you parked.

Outside of work, I enjoy DJing, music production, graphic design, photography, and chess.

https://marcelperez.com/

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led Android workstreams across the Dasher and Consumer apps, from scoping with product and design through launch
- Architected a map platform replacing fragmented code across 5 apps and speeding up feature work; led cross-team migration
- Built pickup and drop-off flows unifying the DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo courier apps on a new architecture
- Rebuilt Consumer address entry with a server-driven screen tailored by address type, improving delivery and pin accuracy
- Piloted SDUI in the Dasher app to enable faster iteration on the drop-off screen, and rebuilt it with Jetpack Compose
- Mentored engineers on Jetpack Compose and the map platform, and guided designers contributing Android code with AI tools

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Delivered Android features on the Maps Navigation team, improving the navigation experience for millions of drivers globally
- Drove the team's Java-to-Kotlin migration, setting Kotlin guidelines, converting 60 files, and raising test coverage
- Shipped on-route UI for road furniture, eco-friendly routes, and rider route preferences, authoring each features design document
- Ran bug bashes and instrumented analytics for each launch, and extended cross-platform code between Android and iOS

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Maintained Yelp's design system components and planned their Jetpack Compose adoption with the Core Android team
- Led accessibility audits across Android teams, training engineers on WCAG standards and coordinating a third-party auditor
- Wrote accessibility utilities for shared UI components, letting feature teams add screen-reader support in one call
- Co-produced the Android MVP of Waitlist Kiosk, where restaurant guests join and track their place in line
- Identified requirements with business system admins, in order to code full-stack Salesforce tools for sales representatives
- Upgraded data pipelines for sales infrastructure in Python to improve scalability, reliability, and performance

positions.title: Internal Systems Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed internal tools for a restaurant point-of-sale startup, simplifying software and hardware setup for chain clients
- Automated menu onboarding for restaurant clients in Python, replacing manual entry of hundreds of items per menu
- Generated food-prep instruction images from spreadsheet data with a Python, Bash, and ImageMagick pipeline
- Engineered a Flask web app in Python and HTML, for real-time monitoring of metrics on local networking devices

positions.title: Software Tester
positions.description:
- Developed test cases and technical reports on software issues for ship software suite used by the U.S. DoD
- Regression-tested software in team environment, ensuring functionality met requirements
- Maintained test plans and reported defects to developers through Jira

positions.title: Safety Inspector
positions.description:
- Conducted over 100 internal safety inspections on exterior house painting practices throughout California
- Delivered divisional presentations: taught safety techniques, announced infractions, and promoted safety awareness to prevent painter injuries and deaths
- Collaborated weekly with nationwide inspectors on company regulations, statistics, and inspecting practices

positions.title: Sales Associate
positions.description:
- Assessed customer needs to properly sell shoes that fulfill specific characteristics
- Communicated with and persuaded purchase to customers of all ages and needs
- Constantly recorded and updated floor inventory from the back stock

honors.title: Eagle Scout Rank
honors.description: Eagle Scout is the highest advancement rank in Boy Scouting, only obtained by a small percentage of Boy Scouts (7% in 2013). The necessary requirements to achieve this rank often take years to fulfill, including an extensive service project that must be planned, organized, lead, and managed by the Scout. Eagle Scout must demonstrate Scout Spirit, an ideal attitude based upon the Scout Oath and Law, service, and most importantly, leadership.
honors.issuer: Issued by Boy Scouts of America (BSA) · Dec 2012

volunteerExperiences.description:
- Taught Catechism to a group of first-graders after school at local church
- Learned the difficulties of delivering information to young children, as well as how to keep them continually focused on the task at hand

- Fund-raised by selling dance team branded shirts, self-designed with Photoshop
- Choreographed for school dance shows, rallies, homecoming, talent shows, community events, and local dance competitions
- Created music mixes by compiling and producing songs with Fruity Loops
- Planned and coordinated daily rehearsal times for the team

projects.description:
JSON REST API server that returns roulette results, based on HTTP request parameters.

(No longer up at the website.)

projects.title: Spot
projects.description:
Spot is a one-tap car location saving Android application. Users can also add notes and a picture to help for later. When it comes to finding the car, a route is drawn on the map from the user's current location. If needed, the user can open Google Navigation or look at the Google Street View of the car's location.

See the Google Play Store listing in the link below.
